title: W9 F3 -- Apply the saved interface font at once and never reset it on a failed font list (REVIEW.md B-S1)
description: Follow work order B-S1 in docs/agent-work/2026-11-10-ui-wave-9/REVIEW.md exactly. src/fonts/registry.ts about lines 70-84: the chosen interface font is applied only after two async loads (Futura flashes at every launch), and if the native installed-font list fails once a saved installed font is reset to Futura for good. Fix: apply the saved font first; reset only when the list actually loaded and the font is truly absent. Fail-first unit tests in src/fonts/registry.test.ts for both cases. Verify: npx vitest run src/fonts; npx tsc -b; PLAYWRIGHT_PORT=1440 npx playwright test tests/w9-fonts.spec.ts tests/appearance.spec.ts --output test-results/F3 (serial lock). Write notes/F3.md. No commits.

review.note: Approved (agent-23c2). src/fonts/ is untracked, so no git diff: read registry.ts and registry.test.ts in full. initFonts sets --ui-font from the saved value at line 72, before any await; reset only when selected!=saved AND installed.length>0 (lines 82-84); a rejected or empty installed list keeps both the key and --ui-font. PREF_KEY folio.workspace.interfaceFont unchanged (line 21); initFonts(): Promise<void> unchanged, single caller main.tsx:13; tsc clean. 'Loaded = non-empty' is sound: macOS families() (sysfonts.rs:33-49) returns Core Text's full family list, never legitimately empty; the non-mac branch returns Err, which system.ts turns into []; browser preview is always [] by design. Consequence: in preview a saved font missing from built-in/added lists is no longer reset at start-up; it falls through its CSS stack. Removing an added font in Settings still resets the interface font (AppearanceSettings.tsx:48), and w9-fonts' remove path passed. Fail-first: 3 of the 4 new tests failed before (F3-fail-first.txt); the 4th (truly-absent reset) guards existing behaviour and passing before is expected. Reruns: npx vitest run src/fonts 28/28 passed; npx tsc -b exit 0; PLAYWRIGHT_PORT=1440 playwright w9-fonts+appearance 22/22 passed (log node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/r4-23c2/T281-pw.log). FOLLOW-UP for the coordinator (same failure class as B-S1, outside this work order): listUserFonts().catch(() => []) at registry.ts:73 makes a failed native font_list look like 'no added fonts'; with the installed list loaded, a saved ADDED font is then reset to Futura for good. Suggested fix: track whether listUserFonts rejected and skip the reset in that case, plus one unit test (listUserFonts rejects, installed ['Georgia'], saved '"My Font", sans-serif' stays).
